data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate increased net technical reserves by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 1.5m) as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL.

prior_year_events.event_name: Deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL
prior_year_events.impact_description: Deteriorations on a whole account quota share caused an increase in net technical reserves for prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior-year deterioration: net technical reserves increased by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years driven by adverse development on a whole-account quota share with AXA XL. The movement was reported net of reinsurance; gross prior-year movement was not presented explicitly in the movement note. The balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2018 of GBP 262.747m.
raw_causal_phrases: increased net technical reserves by GBP 8.8m in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 1.5m) as a result of deteriorations on a whole account quota share of AXA XL

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure used is the NET amount (GBP 8.8m) as explicitly stated in note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding'. A gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) was not clearly presented in the movement note; a gross claims development triangle is present (page 21) but extraction was ambiguous from scanned image, so the explicit net figure was used as a last-resort fallback. Gross triangle included below for reference; users should treat the prior-year gross movement as uncertain.
